reads_as_reason: A clean, smooth, quiet shell, but still a near-straight rounded-rectangle column with large flat faces and a sawn-off knee cut: a good blank, not a finished product.

G1.evidence: No toy cues, but the thigh is a slab with near-parallel sides and squared-off top; zebra 3/4 shows big flat bands (S4a FAIL 0.4341).

G2.evidence: Each segment is one continuous form, silhouettes follow the target with no ledges (S3a 0). The knee is weak: hard planar diagonal cut, flat elliptical cap in the back view, plain rounded thigh end.

G3.evidence: Clay only; recess not rendered. The seam line and the knee gap are the only separation cues.

G4.evidence: Similar rounded-rectangle sections and corner radii; same smooth contour flow in the front view.

G6.evidence: No references. Matches Optimus / Atlas on smooth simple shells, wider thigh and a knee-cap bulge; not on taper (P8a 0.708, P8b 0.712 fail) or sculpted knee and ankle transitions.

pairwise.evidence: Baseline (design-2) has a wavy, lumpy outline (pinched mid-thigh, bulge above the knee, swollen shank), visible contour rings and chaotic zebra; hand-sculpted and unfinished. The candidate has smooth monotonic forms, calm zebra bands and no ledges. Its remaining weakness is blockiness, not lumpiness.

top_changes.change: More thigh taper so sides stop looking parallel (P8a).
Lower n toward 3-3.5 at mid stations to cut flat share; round the shank top edge so the cut is a recess lip.

notes: Viewed baseline first (Image A) and candidate second (Image B). Colour not rendered; no references.
